task: Transparent geospatial levelized-cost model for delivered African green hydrogen to Europe by 2030 via ammonia shipping and reconversion
primary_outputs: Scenario-wise delivered cost of African green hydrogen at each site
Least-cost and competitive African locations under multiple financing and policy scenarios
Comparison against European green hydrogen production benchmark(s)
Quantification of de-risking and interest-rate effects on competitiveness
named_commitments: delivery pathway via ammonia shipping and reconversion
core_method_components: site-wise renewable supply proxy from PV and wind features
distance-linked infrastructure adder terms for grid, road, port/ocean access, and water access
conversion from hydrogen to ammonia, shipping to Europe, and reconversion back to hydrogen
competitiveness metrics such as cost gap and fraction of sites below benchmark
